scope: Authoritative Candidate14 migration/runtime/resource audits and the current Candidate14-r3 gate evidence
interpretation: OTA means a versioned release workflow. MCModSync alone is only the client JAR path; server JAR, paired-side, config, and persistent-data repairs have their own short-stop route.

families.title: Missing goat-horn or optional sound assets
families.route: Publish a client resource-overlay/compatibility JAR with only the missing sound paths and a new immutable catalog-version.
families.startup_blocker: missing sound remains after the overlay canary or the overlay changes unrelated assets

families.title: Invalid or unused animation frames
families.route: Publish corrected client model/animation resources in a versioned overlay JAR; retain the original pack.
families.startup_blocker: hard resource reload error or changed texture/model outside the audited paths

families.title: Duplicate font codepoints
families.route: Ship a client font-resource overlay or corrected client mod under a new catalog-version.
families.startup_blocker: font reload fails or unrelated glyph mappings change

families.title: Optional shader sampler/uniform warnings
families.route: Update the client rendering compatibility mod or shader resource overlay; verify a real screenshot and Render-thread log.
families.startup_blocker: warning becomes a Render-thread ERROR, black screen, or client crash

families.title: Mod version-check timeout
families.route: Ship a client config/mod update that disables or bounds the optional checker; network service health remains an external dependency.
families.startup_blocker: only if the timeout blocks startup or join; otherwise it remains allowlisted telemetry

families.title: Content Backport missing bundle creative-tab anchor
families.route: Publish paired server/client Content Backport compatibility JARs and short-stop the server; no world rewrite is needed.
families.startup_blocker: new registry, startup, or join error after the paired update

families.title: Duplicate ConfigTracker open/overwrite warning
families.route: Update the affected paired mod/config lifecycle implementation in a new release; do not edit production config in place during a running process.
families.startup_blocker: config corruption, load failure, or changed gameplay defaults

families.title: Voice-chat offline encryption warning
families.route: If production authentication requires it, publish matching voice-chat client/server updates plus the approved authentication/proxy configuration; otherwise retain the explicit warning as a security waiver.
families.startup_blocker: authentication topology and voice-chat security mode disagree

families.title: Can't keep up around a failed join probe
families.route: Treat as a symptom, not a data repair: publish a paired/server performance fix only after a reproducible profile and rerun the join/restart gate.
families.startup_blocker: persistent tick starvation or join timeout in a clean canary

families.title: Stale generated datapack IDs
families.route: Run the versioned target-copy sanitizer/datafix after a world snapshot; preserve unknown/custom packs and emit a sidecar.
families.startup_blocker: stale IDs remain, unknown packs are deleted, or second run changes data

families.title: Bukkit metadata pack-format incompatibility
families.route: Apply the bounded metadata datafix in a new server release or offline repair; retain pack description and original artifact hash in the ledger.
families.startup_blocker: metadata remains unreadable or the original pack is lost

families.title: Moon transfer function permission mismatch
families.route: Publish the corrected server datapack/config artifact through a new server release; keep function bodies and endpoint configuration unchanged.
families.startup_blocker: function reload/permission errors or endpoint mutation

families.title: Stale optional Kaleidoscope Nether global-loot references
families.route: Publish sanitized matching server/client JARs with a new pair lock when the optional integration is absent; preserve the original JAR in the release backup.
families.startup_blocker: optional integration warning becomes a load failure or JAR pair diverges

families.title: Create optional simulated DataMaps present without simulated
families.route: Publish matching sanitized Create JARs for the actual dependency set; keep the maps when simulated is later added through a new audited release.
families.startup_blocker: missing DataMap causes startup failure or optional dependency is silently introduced

families.title: MCModSync controlled HTTPS/catalog supply-chain readiness
families.route: Publish immutable objects first, then v4 catalog and Config.jar over controlled HTTPS; externally verify lengths, hashes, redirects, and a Prism canary.
families.startup_blocker: missing/invalid manifest, hash mismatch, cross-origin redirect, or missing recovery marker handling

not_independent_errors.reason: This is an intentional safety policy, not a defect.
not_independent_errors.handling: Keep syncResourcePacks=false; repair render assets with a client overlay JAR and never overwrite the user's local ZIP.

not_independent_errors.reason: This is an intentional safety policy, not a defect.
not_independent_errors.handling: Keep syncServerList=false and preserve the original server address/port list.

not_independent_errors.reason: A disconnect after a failed gate is an observation, not a separate migration defect.
not_independent_errors.handling: Classify the underlying server/client marker; unknown markers fail closed.
